rows.basis: Gross 'Computer equipment and software' 60,631M − 51,250M = 9,381M. This is the predecessor name of 'Servers, network equipment, and software' (FY2025 balances are identical, 132,836M). It counts all server, network and software growth, not only AI, nets out disposals, and includes finance-lease assets; buildings and land are excluded.

Gross 'Computer equipment and software' 74,961M − 60,631M = 14,330M. This is the predecessor of the servers and network category. It counts all server and software growth, not only AI, and includes finance-lease assets; buildings and land are excluded.

Gross 'Computer equipment and software' 93,780M − 74,961M = 18,819M. It counts all server and software growth, not only AI, and includes finance-lease assets (the finance lease liability grew from 17.1B to 27.1B); buildings and land are excluded.

Gross 'Computer equipment and software' 132,836M − 93,780M = 39,056M. This is the same balance later reported as 'Servers, network equipment, and software'. It counts all server growth, not only AI, and includes finance-lease assets; buildings and land are excluded.

Gross 'Servers, network equipment, and software' 215,874M − 132,836M = 83,038M. It counts all server and network growth, not only AI, and includes finance-lease assets (the finance lease liability grew from 46.2B to 66.6B); buildings (+44.8B) and land are excluded.
